question: To which deliverable is the V0-S2 human experience / range obligation bound, now that the unified React/FastAPI frontend (candidate 621b1bf) has been approved by the project owner as the human acceptance surface for the video capability, and while the original V0-S2 human signature on candidate 719c745 (Comfy-native) remains outstanding at 7/8?

missing_item_evidence.document_that_lists_it_as_a_prerequisite: docs/30_V1_REVISED_EXECUTION_PLAN.md (S2/S3 准入: 现有统一切片实际体验签署，原S2范围判定)

constraints_that_any_adjudication_must_s.text: Do not fabricate an S2 human signature; keep S2 at 7/8 and retain the old machine/independent facts
Old S2 remains 7/8 unsigned; the Comfy UI is no longer the human acceptance entry for this route
Retain V0-S2/S3 original obligations AND their prerequisite gates; do not cancel S3; do not pass new multi-shot results off as the old quality denominator
V0.1 video and V0.2 install/rollback/full quality are not cancelled, only deferred in execution order
The 2026-11-11 signature covers only the current unified slice; it must not be extended to old S2/V0.2/full R1/full V1/release
The old slice human signature is not waived
Actual experience and release signatures are still performed by the human
An isolated review instance does not implement the candidate and does not sign Stage PASS

options.title: Re-bind the V0-S2 human experience/range obligation for the demonstrated video capability subset to the already-signed unified slice, and explicitly record what remains unconfirmed
must_state: S2 machine 9/9 and independent Fatal0/Major0 stay bound to candidate 719c745
V0.2 cumulative gate remains V0-A01..A12 all passing and must be re-run on the S3 candidate
V0-A11 (10 images >=8 usable, 0 critical hallucinations) and V0-A12 (6 videos >=5 usable, 0 critical hallucinations) must be freshly run on the S3 candidate with independent pre-annotation
The 2026-11-11 human confirmation was given on a synthetic structural fixture and carries zero content-quality evidence
V0-A06 offline incremental migration / install / rollback is untouched and must be built and run
The Comfy-native node-graph interaction is recorded as NOT human-confirmed and therefore not claimed
No V0.1 pass, no V0.2 pass, no V0 release, no full V1 pass; allowed_claim stays V0_MIN_ACCEPTED_NOT_RELEASED
The eleven human holdouts stay NOT_RUN and protected
options.cost: User does not have to learn Comfy; V0-S2 human gate can close. V0-S3 still owes the full twelve cases and an independent quality set.
options.risk: A judgement that the Comfy-native experience was never confirmed must be carried forward honestly into the V0.2 record.

options.title: User actually exercises the Comfy-native path and signs the original candidate unchanged
options.cost: No new product code, original evidence chain preserved.
options.risk: Runs against the docs/27 approved intent of not requiring the user to learn Comfy first; requires additional user effort.

options.title: Treat the old S2 as already signed on the strength of the unified-slice signature
